lead.headline: Tuten misses Wednesday; Likely turns questionable
lead.deck: Two starters in doubt and no tight end behind one of them. Both fallbacks are decided now, for Sunday 10:30.
lead.body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise on Wednesday with the foot and ankle, Adam Schefter reported at 21:13 UTC, and your opponent, Footballers, own the back who replaces him. Isaiah Likely is now questionable with a groin he hurt in practice last week; he was limited Wednesday, which Rotoworld reads as a good sign, but there is no tight end behind him. Stefon Diggs, the receiver this morning's plan put in Tuten's place, missed Wednesday for a personal reason. So the Sunday plan changes: if Tuten sits, Travis Etienne Jr. takes the seat, because Diggs kicks off after everything else has locked. If Likely sits, add T.J. Hockenson — a free agent from Thursday 02:00 — or Chig Okonkwo, dropping Etienne. You swapped the Steelers D/ST for the Chargers, who face Tommy DeVito. ESPN has the game a coin flip.
